models_evaluated: 11 local LLM model families (full-precision vs quantized variants)
commercial LLM APIs (standard vs distilled 'Nano' models)

links.outcome: Decision instability (flip rate) across repeated runs of commercial LLM APIs
links.effect: Distilled 'Nano' models showed nearly double the decision instability of standard counterparts (2.82% vs. 1.58% Flip Rate); non-determinism attributed to SMoE routing.
links.quote: Furthermore, a longitudinal audit of commercial APIs revealed a distinct "Stability Gap": distilled "Nano" models exhibited nearly double the decision instability (2.82% vs. 1.58% Flip Rate) of their standard counterparts.

unlisted_practices: Single-token forced-choice logit probe (behavioral fingerprinting) to detect quantization or distillation differences between model variants
Stability (flip rate) auditing of compressed or distilled models before clinical deployment

screen.practice: pre-deployment model stability auditing (logit fingerprint / flip rate monitoring)
screen.reason: Empirical study developing and testing a pre-deployment auditing method (logit fingerprinting / stability probe) to detect compression-induced behavioral instability in LLMs for clinical use.

primary.practice: stability auditing and model fingerprinting before clinical deployment
